audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Cassiopeia for all seven rows while whys[0] calls Level 1 feeble for both, whys[1] says the short trades at 2 are yours, whys[4] calls Level 6 your guaranteed kill window and whys[5] calls first item genuinely contested.
audit.why: A flat seven-row Cassiopeia chart contradicted four of its own why cells; the packet levelChart (Skill / Mordekaiser / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Mordekaiser / Skill / Cassiopeia) matches the whys exactly.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, and phases[2], [3], [5] and [6] why-text rewritten to state why each side holds its row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma was the tracked cooldown on ten surfaces with no duration; Noxious Blast and Twin Fang had no numbers either.
audit.why: Miasma at 24s rank 1 is the longest cooldown in her kit and the whole engage plan hangs on it being spent.
audit.corrected: Miasma written as 24s at rank 1 in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[3] and phases[5]; Noxious Blast as a 3.5s 850-range cycle and Twin Fang as a 0.75s heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze was never described. It stuns only enemies facing her and merely slows anyone with their back turned — the single most actionable interaction on the page, and it was absent. Twin Fang’s heal was also unanswered.
audit.why: Riot’s R text states the facing rule outright; the E text says it heals her for a percentage of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d and report[5].t tell you to turn away the instant she casts R; dontsFull[0].d and report[8].t add the Twin Fang heal and Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Cassiopeia off her wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every Miasma cooldown.
edits.after: Her Noxious Blast ranks up on a 3.5s cycle at 850 range while your Obliterate reaches 675. Whiff the pull and she simply chips you out from range for free.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Cassiopeia must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Through 4-5 she only steps up when Miasma's 24s is ready, and her ranged DPS pulls ahead any time the pull misses your aura.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's makes your all-in lethal, but her first item lands too — this swings on whether Miasma's 24s is up when you commit.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Cassiopeia's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Rylai's and Liandry's pin you in chip range while her passive move speed kites the aura out of reach. R is your only equalizer — save it to isolate her in a fight, not a sidelane duel.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1; it grounds and slows you inside the cloud. Only commit while it is spent.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 24s at rank 1 and it grounds and slows you inside the cloud. Only engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Chase his kite without passive up
edits.after: Chase her kite without the aura up

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her on a 0.75s cycle — chasing outside your aura just feeds it.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns everyone facing her and only slows the ones with their back turned, so turn and walk away the instant you see the cast.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — E-pull + Q, then R the 1v1.
edits.after: Miasma: 24s at rank 1, grounding and slowing you in the cloud. Petrifying Gaze only stuns you if you are facing her — turn and run.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment, then Riftmaker, plus Grievous Wounds — Twin Fang heals her every 0.75s; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Bami's (≈900-1300g).

edits.before: Chase his kite without passive up. Waste Q on minions. Ult a target with escapes still up. Realm of Death steals 10% of their stats and isolates the duel — it is the matchup eraser, never a poke tool.
